title: HandoffContract v1
status: DESIGN — NOT BUILT. Priority NEXT. Nothing writes or validates this today.
x-notes: NOT a new store. A HandoffContract is written as a TaskStore.add_evidence row (kind='handoff', evidence_class per factory/evidence.py) plus one HANDOFF event. It inherits append-only, the evidence gate and the existing close refusal for free.

NAME COLLISION, deliberate and load-bearing: factory/handoff.py generates PROSE lane and session closing notes into .data/handoffs/. It is a different concept wearing the same word and must not be renamed into this one.
The six write-time refusals are listed in x-refusals. Three are expressible in JSON Schema and are encoded below; three need the writer.
not_done MUST be present. An empty list is a claim that nothing was left undone; an absent key is nobody having asked. That is the ZERO vs NOT-RECORDED distinction the whole estate turns on.
x-refusals: permits absent while access is WRITE                  -> schema (dependentSchemas)
a CONFIRMED claim with no evidence_ref                -> schema (if/then)
verification.verdict PASS not produced by a GreenContract -> writer; events._verdict_value already forces the enum
an artifacts_to_consume ref that does not resolve on disk -> writer

run.description: factory.events run id — the join to the stream

seq.description: monotonic per RunLog. Ordering authority; NOT the timestamp — two events in one run share a timestamp to the microsecond.

requested.description: The objective AS GIVEN, verbatim from the task contract. Not restated: a restatement is where a brief quietly narrows.

not_done.description: In scope and not completed. REQUIRED. [] is an assertion, never a default.

class.description: factory/evidence.py. Coverage is ABSENT | ASSERTED | SATISFIED — three states, never two.

sha.description: The NACK_STALE discriminator. Without it 'stale context' is a judgement call.

then.description: ⭐ The rule that stops a suggestion becoming a requirement, and an UNKNOWN becoming a FACT across a boundary. A claim cannot be upgraded to CONFIRMED without naming new evidence.

dangerous_assumptions.description: An ASSUMPTION whose falsity would change the output. Distinguished from ordinary assumptions because only these justify stopping.

failure_family.description: ✅ BUILT — mirrors factory.preflight.FAMILIES. UNCLASSIFIED is a legitimate answer; it is NOT the same as the key being absent (NOT-RECORDED).

verdict.description: Five, never four. ERROR outranks FAIL (TTCN-3 ITU-T Z.140 §24.2): once the apparatus broke we cannot claim the failure we saw was real.

contract.description: The GreenContract name that assigned it. Never the agent, never the provider.

then.description: WRITE access must name what it may write to.
